Where the project takes payments: connect the App Store, Google Play, Stripe or a payment source,
check that they work, map their store products to products and import their purchase history.

Usage:
  voidhash provider <command> [flags]

Aliases:
  provider, providers

Commands:
  list                 List where the project takes payments, with each provider's health.
  view                 Show a payment provider's status, store products and imports.
  connect              Connect a store with its credentials, or add a payment source.
  test                 Check that Voidhash can reach a provider with what is saved.
  edit                 Rename a provider, turn it on or off, or change a payment source's endpoints.
  products             List the store products providers sell and what each is mapped to.
  map                  Map a store product to a product, so buying it grants the product's perks.
  unmap                Remove a store product's mapping to a product made by mistake.
  import               Import the purchases Stripe or a payment source recorded earlier.
  delete               Delete a payment provider that no store product is mapped to.
  record-payment       Record a payment a payment source took by hand, or a refund of one.
  refund               Refund a charge at its payment source.
  cancel-subscription  Cancel a subscription at its payment source.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash provider <command> --help' for more about a command.
